limitations: Establishes that correction placement can affect output membership under a cap.
Does not establish that an actual tile loses a detection slot or that accuracy, counts or any metric improve.
Origin labels are authored assumptions, not a production provenance detector.
Zero-union overlap refuses; this example evaluates only zero-versus-positive or positive-versus-positive unions.
Genuine invalid geometry remains a refusal, not an automatically excluded placeholder.
nms_rule: suppress IoU > 1/2; continuous coordinates; score descending with stable ties
scope: Possible-input counterexample; authored origins, scores and boxes. No empirical model outputs, image, data or source modules read.
